tos.title: Terms of Service
tos.content: Welcome to Mysterio. By purchasing from our store, you agree to our terms. All transactions are final unless subject to our 24-hour replacement/refund window. We do not tolerate abuse or fraudulent disputes. Keep your account secure as you are responsible for all activity on it.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content: We only collect minimal information (email) necessary to manage your account and deliver purchases. We use secure session authentication to keep you logged in. We do not sell or share your data with any third parties. All credentials and payment details are handled via secure channels.
